lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਹੋਈਐ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa teraa chhodeeai bhaaee hoeeai sabh kee dhoor ||
lines.translation: Give up your sense of mine and yours, O Siblings of Destiny, and become the dust of the feet of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਪੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat braham pasaariaa bhaaee pekhai sunai hajoor ||
lines.translation: In each and every heart, God is contained, O Siblings of Destiny; He sees, and hears, and is ever-present with us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਮਰੀਐ ਝੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit din visarai paarabraham bhaaee tit din mareeai jhoor ||
lines.translation: On that day when one forgets the Supreme Lord God, O Siblings of Destiny, on that day, one ought to die crying out in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਮਰਥੋ ਭਾਈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan samaratho bhaaee sarab kalaa bharapoor ||4||
lines.translation: He is the all-powerful Cause of Causes, O Siblings of Destiny; he is totally filled with all powers. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: prem padaarath naam hai bhaaee maaiaa moh binaas ||
lines.translation: The Love of the Name is the greatest treasure, O Siblings of Destiny; through it, emotional attachment to Maya is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਭਾਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis bhaavai taa mel lae bhaaee hiradai naam nivaas ||
lines.translation: If it is pleasing to His Will, then He unites us in His Union, O Siblings of Destiny; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਰਿਦੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh kamal pragaaseeai bhaaee ridai hovai paragaas ||
lines.translation: The heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth, O Siblings of Destiny, and the heart is illumined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: pragat bhaiaa parataap prabh bhaaee mauliaa dharat akaas ||5||
lines.translation: The Glory of God has been revealed, O Siblings of Destiny, and the earth and sky have blossomed forth. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai sa(n)tokhiaa bhaaee ahinis laagaa bhaau ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with contentment, O Siblings of Destiny; day and night, I remain attached to the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa raam ravai sadaa bhaaee saachaa saad suaau ||
lines.translation: My tongue continually chants the Lord's Name, O Siblings of Destiny; this is the true taste, and the object of human life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karanee sun sun jeeviaa bhaaee nihachal paaiaa thaau ||
lines.translation: Listening with my ears, I hear and so I live, O Siblings of Destiny; I have obtained the unchanging, unmoving state.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਭਾਈ ਸੋ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jis parateet na aavaee bhaaee so jeeaRaa jal jaau ||6||
lines.translation: That soul,which does not place its faith in the Lord shall burn, O Siblings of Destiny. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬੈ ਭਾਈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu gun mere saahibai bhaaee hau tis kai bal jaau ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master has so many virtues, O Siblings of Destiny; I am a sacrifice to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ ਪਾਲਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu niraguneeaare paaladaa bhaaee dei nithaave thaau ||
lines.translation: He nurtures even the most worthless, O Siblings of Destiny, and gives home to the homeless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਭਾਈ ਗੂੜਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rijak sa(n)baahe saas saas bhaaee gooRaa jaa kaa naau ||
lines.translation: He gives us nourishment with each and every breath, O Siblings of Destiny; His Name is everlasting.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਮਾਉ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jis gur saachaa bheteeai bhaaee pooraa tis karamaau ||7||
lines.translation: One who meets with the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, does so only by perfect destiny. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis bin ghaRee na jeeveeai bhaaee sarab kalaa bharapoor ||
lines.translation: Without Him, I cannot live, even for an instant, O Siblings of Destiny; He is totally filled with all powers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਭਾਈ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saas giraas na visarai bhaaee pekhau sadaa hajoor ||
lines.translation: With every breath and morsel of food, I will not forget Him, O Siblings of Destiny; I behold Him ever-present.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g milaaiaa bhaaee sarab rahiaa bharapoor ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meet Him, O Siblings of Destiny; He is totally pervading and permeating everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਗੀਆ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮਰਦੇ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa preet na lageeaa bhaaee se nit nit marade jhoor ||8||
lines.translation: Those who do not embrace love for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, always die crying out in pain. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਇ ਤਰਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)chal laai taraaiaa bhaaee bhaujal dukh sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Grasping hold of the hem of His robe, O Siblings of Destiny, we are carried across the world-ocean of fear and pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਅੰਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa nadar nihaaliaa bhaaee keeton a(n)g apaar ||
lines.translation: By His Glance of Grace, He has blessed us, O Siblings of Destiny; He shall be with us until the very end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan seetal hoiaa bhaaee bhojan naam adhaar ||
lines.translation: My mind and body are soothed and calmed, O Siblings of Destiny, nourished by the food of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਭਾਈ ਜਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੯॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tis saranaagatee bhaaee j kilabikh kaatanahaar ||9||1||
lines.translation: Nanak has entered His Sanctuary, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord is the Destroyer of sins. ||9||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਹ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat garabh dukh saagaro piaare tah apanaa naam japaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The womb of the mother is an ocean of pain, O Beloved; even there, the Lord causes His Name to be chanted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਪਸਰੀਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: baahar kaadh bikh pasareeaa piaare maaiaa mohu vadhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: When he emerges, he finds corruption pervading everywhere, O Beloved, and he becomes increasingly attached to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕੀਤੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no keeto karam aap piaare tis pooraa guroo milaaiaa ||
lines.translation: One whom the Lord blesses with His kind favor, O Beloved, meets the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so aaraadhe saas saas piaare raam naam liv laaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: He worships the Lord in adoration with each and every breath, O Beloved; he is lovingly attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan teree tek hai piaare man tan teree tek ||
lines.translation: You are the support of my mind and body, O Beloved; You are the support of my mind and body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਏਕ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh bin avar na karanahaar piaare a(n)tarajaamee ek || rahaau ||
lines.translation: There is no other Creator except for You, O Beloved; You alone are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot janam bhram aaiaa piaare anik jon dukh paai ||
lines.translation: After wandering in doubt for millions of incarnations, he comes into the world, O Beloved; for uncounted lifetimes, he has suffered in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib visariaa piaare bahutee milai sajaai ||
lines.translation: He has forgotten his True Lord and Master, O Beloved, and so he suffers terrible punishment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin bhetai pooraa satiguroo piaare se laage saachai naai ||
lines.translation: Those who meet with the Perfect True Guru, O Beloved, are attached to the True Name.
